evidence_scope: Raw files and checked-in code/contracts; no running Silver catalog inspected

dataset.name: USDA FAS - Production, Supply and Distribution (PSD) (Silver)
World Bank - Commodity Markets Pink Sheet (Silver)

products: Communion wafers, empty cachets of a kind suitable for pharmaceutical use, sealing wafers, rice paper and similar products.

manifest_structure.note: These21 pinned observation files plus NSO support metadata are transferred separately. Never substitute the Trade fixture or rely on existing volumes.

columns.name: year_key
columns.settings: [not null, ref: > Dim_Year.year_key, note: 'Rollup FK to Dim_Year (YYYY)']

columns.name: harvest_season_code
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'VNM harvest calendar: WINTER_SPRING_PEAK (Feb-Apr), SUMMER_AUTUMN_PEAK (Jun-Aug), AUTUMN_WINTER_MAIN (Sep-Nov), OFF_SEASON (Jan, May, Dec)']

columns.name: month_key
columns.settings: [not null, ref: > Dim_Month.month_key, note: 'Rollup FK to Dim_Month (YYYYMM)']

columns.name: crop_year_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown.']

columns.name: crop_year_label
columns.settings: [not null, unique, note: 'Preserved from USDA PSD crop_year (e.g., 2023/2024)']

columns.name: start_year
columns.settings: [not null, ref: > Dim_Year.year_key, note: 'Marketing year beginning year (market_year in Silver)']

columns.name: end_year
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Ending year of the crop cycle']

columns.name: season_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown.']

columns.name: season_code
columns.settings: [not null, unique, note: 'From silver.nso_rice_statistics: winter_spring, summer_autumn, summer_autumn_fall, autumn_winter, main_rainy, annual']

columns.name: season_name_vi
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Lua Dong Xuan, Lua He Thu, Lua Thu Dong, Lua Mua, Ca nam']

columns.name: is_annual_summary
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'True if season_code == annual (prevents double counting when summing seasons)']

columns.name: source_system_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown.']

columns.name: source_code
columns.settings: [not null, unique, note: 'FAOSTAT_QCL, FAOSTAT_TM, FAOSTAT_SUA, FAOSTAT_PP, USDA_PSD, USDA_YEARBOOK, WORLDBANK_PINKSHEET, VN_NSO, VN_TTNS']

columns.name: publishing_org
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'FAO, USDA FAS, USDA ERS, World Bank, GSO/NSO Vietnam, ThiTruongNongSan']

columns.name: country_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown / Unspecified Partner.']

columns.name: iso3_code
columns.settings: [unique, note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (e.g., VNM, THA, IND). Nullable for regional aggregates.']

columns.name: m49_code
columns.settings: [unique, note: 'UN M49 code from FAOSTAT (e.g., 704 for Vietnam)']

columns.name: region_un
columns.settings: [note: 'UN Continent / Macro-region (Asia, Europe, Africa, Americas, Oceania)']

columns.name: is_aggregate
columns.settings: [not null, default: false, note: 'CRITICAL: True for World, Asia, European Union, All countries, etc. Filter is_aggregate = false when summing across countries!']

columns.name: region_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown.']

columns.name: region_code
columns.settings: [not null, unique, note: 'e.g., DBSH, TDMNPB, BTB_DHMT, TAY_NGUYEN, DNB, DBSCL']

columns.name: region_name_vi
columns.settings: [not null, unique, note: 'Matches parent_region_vi in silver.nso_rice_statistics (e.g., Dong bang song Cuu Long)']

columns.name: province_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'SCD Type 2 Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown. NOTE: Do NOT include Ca Nuoc (National Total) here.']

columns.name: province_name_vi
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Normalized Vietnamese name from silver.nso_rice_statistics']

columns.name: valid_to
columns.settings: [not null, default: '9999-12-31', note: 'SCD2 effective end date']

columns.name: legacy_province_key
columns.settings: [not null, ref: > Dim_Vietnam_Province.province_key, note: '63-province boundary member']

columns.name: merged_province_key
columns.settings: [not null, ref: > Dim_Vietnam_Province.province_key, note: '34-province boundary member (2025 reform)']

columns.name: area_allocation_ratio
columns.settings: [not null, default: 1.000000, note: '1.0 for full province merge; fractional if split']

columns.name: product_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown.']

columns.name: product_code
columns.settings: [not null, unique, note: 'Canonical code: RICE_PADDY, RICE_MILLED, RICE_MILLED_5PCT, RICE_BROKEN, RICE_HUSKED, RICE_FRAGRANT, UREA, BRENT_OIL, WHEAT, MAIZE']

columns.name: cpc_code
columns.settings: [note: 'UN CPC code from FAOSTAT (e.g., 0113 for Rice paddy, 23161.02 for Rice milled)']

columns.name: product_category
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'RICE_PRIMARY, RICE_PROCESSED, MACRO_FERTILIZER, MACRO_ENERGY, SUBSTITUTE_GRAIN']

columns.name: processing_stage
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'PADDY, HUSKED_BROWN, MILLED_WHITE, BROKEN, BYPRODUCT, NON_RICE']

columns.name: standard_paddy_to_milled_factor
columns.settings: [note: 'Default reference conversion factor (e.g., 0.6500-0.6700) when country-specific PSD milling rate is unavailable']

columns.name: variety_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown.']

columns.name: variety_name_vi
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'From silver.thitruongnongsan commodity (e.g., Lua IR50404, Lua OM5451, Gao ST25, Gao 5% tam)']

columns.name: product_key
columns.settings: [not null, ref: > Dim_Rice_Product.product_key, note: 'Links domestic variety/grade to international Dim_Rice_Product for domestic-vs-FOB comparison']

columns.name: price_type_key
columns.settings: [pk, increment, note: 'Surrogate PK. Use -1 for Unknown.']

columns.name: price_type_code
columns.settings: [not null, unique, note: 'e.g., FAO_PRODUCER_USD, FAO_PRODUCER_LCU, FAO_PRODUCER_SLC, FAO_PRODUCER_INDEX, USDA_FOB_EXPORT, WB_FOB_BENCHMARK, VN_DOMESTIC_WHOLESALE, VN_DOMESTIC_RETAIL']

columns.name: currency
columns.settings: [note: 'USD, VND, LCU, SLC, or NULL for dimensionless price index']

columns.name: is_index
columns.settings: [not null, default: false, note: 'CRITICAL: True for price indices (e.g., FAO 5539). Never mix or average with currency prices!']

columns.name: source_commodity_code
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Raw code from Silver (e.g., 0113, rice_thai_5, 0422110)']

columns.name: source_commodity_name
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Raw label from Silver (e.g., Rice, paddy; 5-PERCENT BROKEN)']

columns.name: source_country_code
columns.settings: [note: 'M49 code, USDA country code, or ISO code in Silver']

columns.name: source_country_name
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Exact country/location string in Silver (e.g., Viet Nam, VIETNAM, Thailand, Unspecified)']

columns.name: province_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Vietnam_Province.province_key, note: 'Atomic province only (geography_level = PROVINCE_CITY)']

columns.name: season_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Crop_Season.season_key, note: 'Specific crop season (is_annual_summary = false for seasonal additive grain)']

columns.name: area_planted_ha
columns.settings: [note: 'Normalized from Nghin_ha (* 1000) where measure = area and statistic_kind = QUANTITY']

columns.name: production_harvested_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Normalized from Nghin_tan (* 1000) where measure = production and statistic_kind = QUANTITY']

columns.name: is_preliminary
columns.settings: [not null, default: false, note: 'True if period_raw marked So bo in NSO']

columns.name: region_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Vietnam_Region.region_key, note: 'Use -1 for National (COUNTRY) rows; actual region_key for REGION rows']

columns.name: season_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Crop_Season.season_key, note: 'Includes both seasonal and annual summary rows as published by GSO']

columns.name: geography_level
columns.settings: [pk, note: 'COUNTRY (Ca nuoc) or REGION (6 socio-economic regions)']

columns.name: reported_yield_kg_ha
columns.settings: [note: 'NON-ADDITIVE: Official published yield in kg/ha (from Ta_ha * 100)']

columns.name: product_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Rice_Product.product_key, note: 'Explicitly linked to RICE_MILLED (with rough production tracked in dedicated column)']

columns.name: milling_rate_factor
columns.settings: [note: 'NON-ADDITIVE: Dimensionless milling fraction (e.g., 0.6700) from Silver conversion']

columns.name: year_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Year.year_key, note: 'Calendar year YYYY (fixes missing date_key in v2)']

columns.name: food_supply_kg_per_capita_yr
columns.settings: [note: 'NON-ADDITIVE: Element 645 (kg/capita/year). Do NOT sum across countries!']

columns.name: partner_country_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Country.country_key, note: 'Partner country (maps Unspecified to -1)']

columns.name: product_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Rice_Product.product_key, note: 'Distinguishes Paddy, Husked, Milled, Broken rice']

columns.name: import_value_usd
columns.settings: [note: 'Element 5622: Import value (scaled from 1000 USD * 1000 -> exact USD)']

columns.name: export_value_usd
columns.settings: [note: 'Element 5922: Export value (scaled from 1000 USD * 1000 -> exact USD)']

columns.name: month_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Month.month_key, note: 'STRICTLY MONTHLY GRAIN (YYYYMM). Annual rows (7021) are excluded!']

columns.name: country_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Country.country_key, note: 'Use -1 for global/non-country World Bank benchmarks (e.g., Brent Oil, Urea)']

columns.name: price_type_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Price_Type.price_type_key, note: 'Encapsulates element, currency, unit, and is_index']

columns.name: source_system_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Source_System.source_system_key, note: 'FAOSTAT_PP, USDA_YEARBOOK, or WORLDBANK_PINKSHEET']

columns.name: price_value
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Monthly price or price index value. Filter by Dim_Price_Type.is_index and currency before aggregating!']

columns.name: date_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Date.date_key, note: 'Daily observation date YYYYMMDD']

columns.name: province_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Vietnam_Province.province_key, note: 'Mapped from silver.thitruongnongsan market column; -1 if regional/unspecified']

columns.name: variety_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Rice_Variety.variety_key, note: 'Mapped from silver.thitruongnongsan commodity column']

columns.name: price_type_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Price_Type.price_type_key, note: 'Mapped from silver.thitruongnongsan price_type (Wholesale/Retail)']

columns.name: market_label_raw
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Preserved sub-province market name from Silver']

columns.name: price_vnd_kg
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Observed daily price in VND/kg']

columns.name: region_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Vietnam_Region.region_key, note: 'Fixes [B5]: FK to Dim_Vietnam_Region instead of raw varchar']

columns.name: total_area_planted_ha
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'SUM(area_planted_ha) of atomic provinces in region']

columns.name: total_production_t
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'SUM(production_harvested_t) of atomic provinces in region']

columns.name: national_sum_of_provinces_prod_t
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'Denominator 1: SUM(production_harvested_t) across all atomic provinces nationwide']

columns.name: product_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Rice_Product.product_key, note: 'Fixes [B5]: Explicit product_key so Paddy production vs Milled trade are never conflated']

columns.name: product_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Rice_Product.product_key, note: 'Fixes [B5]: Explicit product_key required for accurate commodity share']

columns.name: partner_share_of_reporter_exports_pct
columns.settings: [note: '100.0 * export_quantity_t / NULLIF(SUM(export_quantity_t) OVER (PARTITION BY year_key, reporter_country_key, product_key), 0)']

columns.name: as_of_month_key
columns.settings: [pk, ref: > Dim_Month.month_key, note: 'Observation cutoff month (t). All features strictly use data available at or before end of month t!']

columns.name: price_vnm_5pct_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Current month (t) VNM 5% broken price (USD/t) - feature for t+1/t+3']

columns.name: price_vnm_5pct_sma_3m_at_t
columns.settings: [note: '3-month Simple Moving Average over window [t-2, t] (strictly <= t)']

columns.name: price_vnm_5pct_volatility_3m_at_t
columns.settings: [note: '3-month rolling std dev over window [t-2, t] (strictly <= t)']

columns.name: price_thai_5pct_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Month t Thailand 5% broken benchmark price (USD/t) from Pink Sheet']

columns.name: price_spread_vnm_thai_at_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Fixes [A4]: price_vnm_5pct_t - price_thai_5pct_t at month t (never at t+1/t+3!)']

columns.name: urea_price_usd_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Month t Urea fertilizer price (USD/mt) from Pink Sheet']

columns.name: brent_oil_price_usd_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Month t Brent crude oil price (USD/bbl) from Pink Sheet']

columns.name: wheat_price_usd_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Month t Wheat benchmark price (USD/mt) from Pink Sheet']

columns.name: harvest_season_code
columns.settings: [not null, note: 'From Dim_Month: WINTER_SPRING_PEAK, SUMMER_AUTUMN_PEAK, AUTUMN_WINTER_MAIN, OFF_SEASON (Fixes [B8])']

columns.name: prior_year_vnm_paddy_prod_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Lagged annual production from year(t) - 1 (prevents look-ahead bias from current unfinished year)']

columns.name: prior_crop_year_vnm_ending_stocks_t
columns.settings: [note: 'Lagged ending stocks from completed PSD crop year prior to month t']
